title: Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Extension Terms Schedule
content:
**Extension terms by tier — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

An extension defers installments of a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract to the end of the term. The figures below set, per tier, how far an extension may go and what it costs.

| Tier | Installments satisfied before an extension | Most days past due at which one may be granted | Installments one extension may defer | Installments deferred over the life of the contract | Extension fee where the state permits one | Good-faith payment (percent of the monthly payment) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5 | 12 | 30 | 1 | 2 | $40.00 | 50 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 4 | 12 | 45 | 1 | 2 | $40.00 | 50 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 3 | 9 | 45 | 1 | 3 | $30.00 | 50 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2 | 9 | 59 | 1 | 3 | $25.00 | 25 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1 | 6 | 59 | 2 | 4 | $0.00 | 0 (none) |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 6 | 59 | 2 | 5 | $0.00 | 0 (none) |

| Term common to every tier | Figure |
|---|---|
| Minimum calendar months between two extensions | 12 |
| No extension when this many installments or fewer remain | 6 |
| Calendar days to complete a signed extension agreement before it expires | 10 |

### Notes

- A good-faith percentage of 0 means no good-faith payment is required on that tier.
- Tier 1 and Tier 1+ carry no extension fee; on the other tiers the fee shown applies only where the contract's state permits an extension fee.
- Hypothetical illustration: on a tier with a 50 percent good-faith requirement and an illustrative monthly payment of $420.00, the good-faith payment is $210.00. The monthly payment is an example value only.
